content: OpenAI official API docs say API content is not used for training by default, while abuse-monitoring retention and endpoint application state have exceptions; ZDR requires eligibility and has endpoint limits. OpenAI rate/spend controls are organization/project scoped, not end-user limits. Anthropic docs expose inference geography for supported recent models and document model/region limits and price multipliers. Per-user hard caps therefore belong in Jobot transactional usage reservations/ledger plus provider-side aggregate alarms; obtain legal/privacy review before making data-handling promises.
